parameters.description:
`msg-to-bulksms-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your BulkSMS account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own BulkSMS accounts — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional BulkSMS accounts bound per enrollment.

BulkSMS sends text messages against credits purchased on your BulkSMS account (sign up and top up credits at bulksms.com/account). The only setup needed here is telling us where to send messages: set BULKSMS_SMS_TO to the recipient's phone number in E.164 format, or to an @-prefixed saved group name from your BulkSMS account.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"to":"${ customer_secrets.BULKSMS_SMS_TO }","body":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *},"routingGroup":"STANDARD","encoding":"TEXT"}
parameters.gateway_body_template_plus: {"to":"${ customer_secrets.{{ params.to_secret }} }","body":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *},"routingGroup":"STANDARD","encoding":"TEXT"}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment BulkSMS destinations, direct
parameters.summary: Send an SMS to your own BulkSMS account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's BULKSMS_SMS_BASIC value (same format as BULKSMS_SMS_BASIC)

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's BULKSMS_SMS_TO value (same format as BULKSMS_SMS_TO)
